issues.desc: CHK-004 context still commits the Story to a documentation-only Dynamic Finding authority migration and to retaining the former combined verdict as an active legacy alias. That is the exact unintended authority-amendment/legacy-alias commitment this controlled replan must remove, and it contradicts CHK-001, which now correctly says the Story is subordinate, must not amend Dynamic Finding authority, and may mention retired verdict vocabulary only as historical evidence—not as active Task Context. Preserve CHK-004 RED/GREEN, full-envelope authority-injection, baseline, build, and adapter acceptance; revise only this stale scope prose so the canonical checks reject active legacy-alias retention.
